thread:
**Issue #1778 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1778: Patch: the AI tries an X card at its biggest X, an Embiggened price, an Equip and a face-down set before a second lane of its cheapest play
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On a big turn the AI looks at only a short list of moves for each card in its hand, and today that list fills up with the same cheap play in different spots before anything else. A card that costs X (pay any amount, get that much effect) is only ever tried at its smallest amounts. A card's other ways of being played, such as its upgraded price, equipping it to a unit or setting it face down, are often never tried at all. So with 6 mana and Buff Billy, which grows with every mana spent, the AI plays it small beside a 2-drop instead of all in as an 18/18. Once built, each card's first tries cover its different ways of being played, biggest X first, before repeating one of them in another lane.

## Why
- The search keeps 20 moves at the root and 6 at each later step (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:40-41`, `root_branching` and `branching`), cut at `crates/ai/src/search.rs:111` (`moves.truncate(width)`). The shipped order is the heuristic one (`AI_MOVE_ORDER = MoveOrder::Heuristic`, `config.rs:551`).
- `round_robin` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, around 413-460) deals every card its first variant, then every card its second, and keeps each card's variants in the engine's listing order. `enemy_first` only interleaves them by aim.
- The engine lists a card's plays price outermost, lowest first:
  - `legal_x_values`: "every X `why_x_refused` passes, lowest first" (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:732`), then `for x in &x_values { for embiggen in &embiggens` (around 2057).
  - The Embiggened price comes second (`vec![false, true]`).
  - Equip plays come after every plain lane ("the plain zones first, then the Equip host zones after them").
  - A face-down set comes last (`out.extend(face_down_play_actions(…))`).
- The lane variants that crowd the rest out are often worth nothing to the search. Its duplicate check leaves a unit's lane out (`crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, around 833-835: "A unit's lane is left out, so the two lanes `candidate_actions` keeps for one play stay one position"), so several of a card's slots collapse into one position.
- On the AI's dealt-deck measure (`DEALT_Q`, `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs`, around 755-773, mean 0.6685 over 261 cards), Adaptive UI (`core-074`, an X spell) reads 0.5815, 75th lowest. The Meditative+ tests (`crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`, around 255-344) check only that a dearer price is a candidate at all, not that it survives the cut.

## Proposal
In `round_robin`, split each source's variants into ways of being played, keyed by `x`, `embiggen`, equip host or not, face-down or not, and the Tribute set:
- Each way gets its first variant before any way gets a second lane or target.
- The ways are taken dearest price first, then cheapest, then the rest, and Tribute sets go cheapest units first.
- `enemy_first` keeps working inside each way.

The beam's widths and the node budget are unchanged.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` (`round_robin`)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs` (or `meditative_plus.rs`)
- `crates/ai/README.md`, and the move-order paragraph of `docs/polish/3-ai.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On a hand wide enough to fill the root, `root_expansion` at `AI_BUDGET.root_branching` holds Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) at `x == mana`, an Embiggened play and a Cloaked card's face-down set.
- [ ] `decide` with 6 mana, Buff Billy and three 2-drops plays Billy at X=6.
- [ ] The B18 lethal puzzles and every `crates/ai` test stay green, and `cargo jackioh gate` passes, its performance probes included.
- [ ] The pull request reports an improve-dev arena screen against the parent (400 paired games), and `stats` before and after for `classicplus-069` and `core-074`.

## Size and risks
Hard, since it is the AI: about 80 lines in one function and about 200 lines of tests.
- The greedy baseline breaks exact ties by this list (`crates/ai/src/baselines.rs:52`), so its play shifts slightly. #1062 is the precedent, or greedy can keep a frozen order.
- Bigger X plays mean more draws and Buffs later in a line, so watch decision time on the perf gate's pinned positions.
- It touches the same move order as #1759, which is in flight, so build it after that.
```
